summary: News Corp filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose routine daily repurchase program disclosures provided to the Australian Securities Exchange. The filing reiterates an existing $1 billion share repurchase authorization for Class A and Class B common stock. It does not announce a new tender offer, material change in the program, or any specific transaction terms. The disclosure is a regulatory formality under ASX rules, not a special situation event. No deal terms, premium, advisor, or board action beyond the standing authorization are reported. This is an ordinary progress report on a previously announced capital return program, not a standalone special situation.
